GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped very awkwardly. Not pushed early & raced behind leader on inside (2L from lead). Tracked leader on inside midrace & pushed to quicken on inside (2L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Two Wide @ 300m & outsprinted in last 200m. Rider fined - failing to ride out. # Every Chance
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began very awkwardly. Threw its head back on a number of occasions passing the 1400m. Inclined to pull in the early and middle stages. Rdr penalised for failing to ride mount out fully over final stride.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok pressed on to lead 1 length clear, joined b4 turn, ridden along turn, joint lead Straightening Up , headed approaching 200m and weaned to the line # led/faded
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began only fairly. A post-race veterinary examination of the gelding did not reveal any abnormality.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped awkwardly missing start 2 Lengths and Settled Down last 9 Lengths from the lead, railed to 5.5 Lengths turning, Lost Ground in Straight # slowly away
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly and lost ground (~2L). Near the 1250m got its head up when being restrained. Near the 900m was steadied after improving onto heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Debut for stable. jumped awkwardly . Not pushed early & raced @ rear Two Wide (8L from lead). Stayed well back 3 Wide midrace & pushed out Five Wide @ 500m. Pushed along Six Wide (7L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Five Wide @ 300m & worked home OK in last 200m. # Slow out/OK late.
Bit Slow Out 1-2 Lengths settled last 6l off, well back turn ridden along, Straightened Up well off, plodded home # tardy/no run on
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Underwent a pre race veterinary examination after it was kicked by another runner. Was deemed suitable to compete. Began awkwardly.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out 1 length settled back 8-9l off, well back turn, Straightened Up well off, plodded home # back/no run on
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began fairly. Near the 1100m, had to be eased to avoid the heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fair settled back 5l off, well back turn, Straightened Up well off, plodded home # poor
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly and made contact with another runner. Raced keenly approaching the 800m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fair drifted back near last 9l off, well back turn, Straightened Up well off, plodded home # back/no run on
Jumped Fair drifted back 10l off, well back turn, Straightened Up well off, plodded home # poor
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly. Overraced during the early and middle stages.
